title: Issue Tracking Workflow
trigger: Issue created from coordination, review, or field feedback

steps.action: Create the issue with the minimum required fields.
Assign an owner, due date, and status.
Track resolution and verify closure evidence.

governance_notes: The source identifies a future Issue Register as supporting governance.
Closure evidence verifies issue resolution state but does not by itself create formal acceptance authority.

provenance.migration_note: Source workflow W5.2 migrated from the workflow catalogue. Future Issue Register remains unresolved.
